title: NarrativePreset
description: Schema for NarrativePreset objects — curated guided narrative sequences for scrollytelling and thematic graph exploration. NarrativePresets reference NarrativeAnchor IDs from narrative-anchors.json and add audience framing, sequence order, and view instructions. Stored in workspace/narratives/presets/.

titleFr.description: French language version of the title.

goal.description: What this narrative is designed to show or demonstrate. One or two sentences.

targetAudience.description: Primary intended audience for this narrative.

status.description: Publication status. Only 'published' presets are included in public/exports/.

viewMode.description: Default graph layout for this narrative. Corresponds to layout options in graphe.html.

evidenceMode.description: How SourceQuote evidence is displayed during this narrative.

steps.description: Ordered array of NarrativeStep IDs. Defines the sequence of the narrative.

anchorIds.description: NarrativeAnchor IDs from narrative-anchors.json that this preset references. Informational — steps carry the detailed anchor references.

chapterScope.description: Thesis chapter indices that this narrative primarily covers. 0=Introduction, 1=Chapitre I, 2=Chapitre II, 3=Chapitre III, 4=Conclusion.

notes.description: Editorial notes about this narrative, open questions, or revision history.

examples.title: CVE-2018: Discrete Governance Unveiled
examples.goal: Show how the CVE-2018-17144 vulnerability reveals a discrete, non-public decision-making mode in Bitcoin governance, tracing the actors, phases, and infrastructure implications.
examples.author: mael-rolland.eth
